scientific_semantics.attack_onset: attack_onset_epoch from authoritative runtime/packet truth carried in prediction archive
scientific_semantics.attack_termination: attack_termination_epoch from authoritative runtime/packet truth carried in prediction archive
scientific_semantics.cdf_denominator: all eligible attack runs, so terminal CDF mass may be <1 when attacks are undetected during attack
scientific_semantics.complete_source_path_victim_rule: source, path and victim exact-set rules all true on the same post-onset decision
scientific_semantics.cycle_conversion: optional only when authoritative cycles_per_epoch is supplied explicitly at execution time
scientific_semantics.graph_positive_rule: graph_probability >= externally supplied frozen graph threshold
scientific_semantics.path_correct_set_rule: thresholded 16-router path probability vector exactly equals path truth vector
scientific_semantics.pre_onset_false_alarm_rule: decision_epoch < attack_onset_epoch and graph decision positive
scientific_semantics.source_correct_set_rule: thresholded 16-router source probability vector exactly equals source truth vector
scientific_semantics.stable_graph_rule: first two consecutive post-onset archive decisions both satisfying frozen graph decision rule
scientific_semantics.undetected_policy: never silently discard; preserve null latency and explicit undetected_during_attack flag
scientific_semantics.victim_correct_set_rule: thresholded 16-router victim probability vector exactly equals victim truth vector

threshold_policy.graph_threshold_source: must be supplied explicitly from a frozen/mainline threshold contract
threshold_policy.role_threshold_source: must be supplied explicitly from a frozen/mainline threshold contract
